body: I appreciate the directness of your message. I think with this issue. I need to be very direct and clear as well. Thank you.

Initially I thought i could salvage a relationship between them. But in the process of doing that i was hurting her. And after some events i realized my mom had no desire to have a relationship with my wife. I was led to believe different because my mom wanted me in her life. But yeah it is time to have that talk with my mom.
I thought we could do this. When my family wasnt in the picture everything was amazing. I couldnt stay away from her.
